title: The hidden cost of handing smartphone to a child | Explained
summary: Paediatricians are witnessing an alarming trend: smartphones being increasingly used as “digital pacifiers” to appease toddlers during mealtime, soothe them when they throw a tantrum and keeping them engaged while managing household chores
llm_summary: Paediatricians are raising alarms about smartphones becoming “digital pacifiers” for toddlers—used to distract kids at meals, calm tantrums, and keep them occupied while parents tackle chores. While the convenience is tempting, experts warn that this habit can hinder early development, affect attention spans, and set the stage for unhealthy screen‑time habits later on.
